title: DedicatedPool: add autoscaling min/max bounds to API + persistence (ENG-2841)
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Dedicated pools can now store autoscaling min/max bounds (min_replicas/max_replicas) in control plane. No behavior change yet; enforcement lands in autoscaler follow-ups.
body:
Title
DedicatedPool: add autoscaling min/max bounds to API + persistence (ENG-2841)

Context
Dedicated autoscaling today is configured with an on/off switch + a target signal, but customers have been asking for strict spend guardrails (hard max) and performance floors (min) as part of bounded autoscaling.

This PR is intentionally scoped to the control plane schema: API fields, persistence, validation, and unit tests. Enforcement/clamping in the fleet autoscaler and policy resolution defaults are in follow-up PRs (ENG-2842/ENG-2843).

What’s in this PR
- Adds two optional fields to DedicatedPool autoscaling config:
  - min_replicas: lower bound for desired replicas (aka min GPUs for 1:1 replica->GPU pools)
  - max_replicas: upper bound for desired replicas
- Persists the fields in the control plane DB (migrated with nullable columns) and returns them via API/Console read paths.
- Adds request validation:
  - Both must be >= 0
  - If both are set: min_replicas <= max_replicas
  - If max_replicas is set: max_replicas must be > 0 when autoscaling.enabled = true (prevents an enabled config that can never run)
  - If autoscaling.enabled = false: bounds may be set but are currently informational (we’ll decide if we want to hard reject this in a later UX pass; see review notes)
- Adds unit tests for:
  - create/update DedicatedPool with bounds
  - partial updates (patch) preserving unset vs explicit null
  - validation error messages (stable strings; used by Console)

Non-goals
- No defaulting logic (defaults will be resolved in policy engine in ENG-2842)
- No runtime enforcement (autoscaler clamp in ENG-2843)
- No UI changes (Console audit + config surface in ENG-2847)

API details
- Field names: min_replicas / max_replicas (preferred over min_gpus/max_gpus for forward-compat with multi-GPU-per-replica SKUs)
- Semantics: values are bounds for the autoscaler’s computed desired replicas; they are not a guarantee of provisioned capacity (capacity shortages/maintenance behavior is defined in ADR-0142)

DB / migration
- Adds columns to dedicated_pools:
  - autoscaling_min_replicas INT NULL
  - autoscaling_max_replicas INT NULL
- Migration is backward compatible:
  - Existing pools remain NULL/NULL
  - Read path maps NULL to “unset” (not 0)

Validation errors
- Returns field-specific errors with machine-stable codes and human messages.
  - Example: AUTOSCALING_BOUNDS_INVALID: min_replicas (4) must be <= max_replicas (2)
  - Example: AUTOSCALING_MAX_INVALID: max_replicas must be > 0 when autoscaling is enabled

Testing
- Added dedicated_pool_autoscaling_bounds_test covering create/update/patch and error cases.
- Added migration test to ensure NULL round-trips correctly.

Follow-ups
- ENG-2842: Policy engine resolution + defaults/cooldown alignment
- ENG-2843: Fleet autoscaler clamps desired replicas to bounds + audit logging

Screenshots
N/A (API + persistence only)

Checklist
- [x] Backward compatible schema change
- [x] Validation + stable error messages
- [x] Unit tests for create/update/patch
- [x] Migration with rollback plan

Commits
1) control-plane: add min/max replicas fields to DedicatedPool autoscaling model
2) api: expose autoscaling bounds in DedicatedPool CRUD endpoints
3) db: migration for autoscaling bounds columns + read/write plumbing
4) validation: enforce min<=max and non-negative bounds
5) tests: unit + migration coverage for bounds + patch semantics

Changed areas (high level)
- controlplane/api/dedicated_pools/*
- controlplane/model/dedicated_pool.go
- controlplane/validation/dedicated_pool_validation.go
- controlplane/db/migrations/20260124_add_autoscaling_bounds.sql
- controlplane/db/repository/dedicated_pools_repository.go
- controlplane/tests/dedicated_pool_autoscaling_bounds_test.go

CI
- build (linux/amd64): pass
- unit tests: pass
- lint: pass
- db migration checks: pass

Review conversation (highlights)
Benji Okafor:
“Do we want to allow setting bounds when autoscaling.enabled=false? Seems confusing.”

Ethan Park (author):
“Agree it’s confusing. I left it permissive so we don’t block customers pre-configuring for later enablement + to keep PATCH semantics simple. Happy to tighten later once Console UX is clear. Added comment to validation to revisit when DES-?? lands.”

Jordan Lee:
“Please ensure NULL vs 0 is distinguishable; policy engine needs to apply defaults only when unset.”

Ethan Park:
“Yep. Columns are nullable and API uses optional ints; tests added to assert round-trip preserves unset.”

Michael Nguyen:
“Migration naming: can we avoid ‘autoscaling_*’ columns on dedicated_pools and instead store JSON? We’ve been moving away from JSON blobs for queryability.”

Ethan Park:
“Went with explicit columns for queryability + future billing/audit needs. If we later move to a separate autoscaling_config table we can migrate cleanly; this keeps the initial change small.”

Vanessa Ortiz:
“Can we add upper bound sanity check (e.g., max_replicas <= regional limit)?”

Ethan Park:
“That coupling is in policy evaluation; control plane doesn’t have authoritative capacity limits. Added a TODO in validation to keep region/hw constraints out of this layer.”

Approvals
- Benji Okafor: Approved
- Jordan Lee: Approved
- Michael Nguyen: Approved
- Vanessa Ortiz: Approved

Merge
- Merged via squash into main
- Squash commit message: “DedicatedPool: add autoscaling min/max bounds schema (ENG-2841)”
